Vietnam’s new crypto enforcement regime takes effect September 1, introducing fines of 30-50 million VND ($1,140-$1,900) for domestic investors caught using unlicensed trading platforms, according to Decree No. 284/2026/ND-CP. The penalties mark the first enforcement teeth attached to a five-year regulatory pilot that began in September 2025 and is designed to run through 2030. Five …
content: Vietnam has introduced a new crypto enforcement regime taking effect September 1, featuring fines ranging from 30 to 50 million VND for investors using unlicensed trading platforms. Decree No. 284/2026/ND-CP marks the first enforcement measures attached to a five-year regulatory pilot running from 2025 through 2030, impacting the country's estimated 17 million cryptocurrency users.
